description: Location: Bangalore office (JP Nagar) Experience: 1 to 3 years Work pattern: Rotational shifts, six-day week Joining: Immediate requirement About the role BrainSightAI is a health-technology company. We process MRI scans from hospitals into brain network and tract results that neurosurgeons use to plan surgery. Every case passes through a fixed sequence of people: Technical Support, Connectomics Technologist, Radiologist, Product Deployment and Clinical Application Specialist. The Technical Support Engineer is the first step in that sequence. You check the data and the pipeline output before anyone else reviews it, you fix what fails, and you are the first point of contact when a hospital has a problem. A missed error at this step reaches the radiologist, and in the worst case the neurosurgeon, so accuracy and timing both matter. **What you will do** 1. Case processing and data checks * Receive incoming hospital cases and confirm the scan data is complete and usable. * Run the processing pipeline and act on the automated QA/QC result. Cases that fail come back to you for troubleshooting; cases that pass are posted to the review channel. * Support tumour segmentation when a T1c sequence is present. * After the radiologist's review, prepare the thresholding file with their changes, and apply the decision on which tracts come from the legacy pipeline and which from the current one. * Create the final result folder and hand the case on for delivery. * Record tracts and cases that fail repeatedly, so the pipeline team can investigate. 2. First and second level customer support * Answer questions and requests from hospitals and internal teams by phone, email, chat or in person. * Diagnose and resolve problems with software, data, networks and hardware at the customer site. * Guide users through troubleshooting steps such as checking connections, triggering the required commands, applying a manual bypass, reinstalling software and making results available to the customer. * Explain technical issues clearly and patiently, without jargon, including to frustrated or confused users. 3. Tickets, bugs and documentation * Create and manage support tickets so that every issue is tracked to resolution within agreed timelines. * Log, reproduce and follow up on bugs with the engineering and ML teams. * Record problems and solutions in the knowledge base, and escalate complex or unresolved issues to the right team. * Manage customer complaints and plan your workload so that no case waits without an owner. 4. Coordination and compliance * Turn comments from the neuro-anatomy reviewer and the radiologist into correct, specific actions on the case. * Follow channel and template discipline, keep file versions clear, and close the loop on every handoff. * Follow company policies and the compliance requirements that apply to us, including ISO and FDA requirements and HIPAA-level handling of patient data. * Collect customer feedback and share what you learn with the team to improve the support process. Shifts, travel and relocation * Rotational shifts as per roster. Current shifts are 4:00 AM to 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM, 11:00 PM - 7:00 AM and timings may change as coverage needs grow. * Six-day work week with one rotational weekly off. * Weekend and public holiday duty is shared across the team by roster, because many elective surgeries are scheduled on holidays. * Willingness to travel to hospitals when required. * Willingness to relocate to the Bangalore office. Who you are * 1 to 3 years of experience in technical support, application support or a similar role. Experience supporting hospitals, imaging or healthcare software is a strong advantage. * Bachelor's degree in biomedical engineering, computer science, electronics and communication, AI/ML, medical imaging technology or a related field. * Clear and courteous communication with customers and with colleagues. * Structured troubleshooting and problem solving, with the habit of finding the root cause. * Coding background in Python. Java is preferred. * Quick to learn and quick to implement, and comfortable working independently. * Good planning, and a high sense of responsibility and accountability for every case you touch.

ai_summary.why: Candidate has strong Java and Kafka experience, aligning with the technical support role's need for data processing and pipeline troubleshooting.
ai_summary.gaps: Lacks specific machine learning and AI skills required for MRI scan analysis and tumor segmentation tasks.

description: Job Description Requirements Experience : 5.5+years Experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or applied AI, including at least 1–2 years of hands-on experience building production-grade LLM applications. Expert-level proficiency in React.js for developing scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications. Strong hands-on experience with Python for AI development, automation, backend services, and API integration. Working knowledge of Java for backend services, REST API development, and enterprise application integration. Practical experience with LLM providers and APIs, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms. Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, system prompts, structured outputs, JSON schemas, function calling, and tool integration. Strong understanding of LLM application development, AI assistants, agentic workflows, and enterprise AI integration. Experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent. Hands-on experience implementing RAG pipelines, including embeddings, document chunking, retrieval tuning, grounding, and vector database integration. Experience with at least one vector database or search platform, such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Azure AI Search, or Vertex AI Vector Search. Working knowledge of LLM evaluation methodologies, including evaluation datasets, regression testing, and frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, or LangSmith. Strong understanding of AI application testing, debugging, observability, performance optimization, and cost management. Basic frontend development knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with backend API development using FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent frameworks. Familiarity with asynchronous programming, Python packaging, testing frameworks, and application development best practices. Knowledge of Shell scripting, Linux fundamentals, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker. Exposure to at least one cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. Basic understanding of Infrastructure Security concepts, including vulnerabilities, patch management, security logs, IAM, and access controls. Awareness of responsible AI and security practices, including prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, bias, and content filtering. Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk, including the ability to write KQL or SPL queries for AI-assisted security detection and investigation. Basic understanding of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and cloud security controls such as Network Security Groups (NSGs), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), IAM policies, and conditional access. Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Bicep for cloud-native AI service deployment and configuration. Exposure to data privacy and regulatory requirements applicable in India, including the DPDP Act and RBI IT Risk Framework, particularly in handling personal and sensitive data within AI systems. Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts, including CVE, CVSS, EPSS scoring, CISA KEV catalogue, and patch prioritization workflows. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug LLM behavior across prompts, retrieval pipelines, and tool integrations. Ability to interpret evaluation metrics, application logs, and security telemetry to improve AI quality, reliability, and operational efficiency. Demonstrated ownership of AI solutions from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, testing, and documentation. Strong learning agility and adaptability to evolving AI models, frameworks, tools, and development practices. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. Certifications such as CISSP, Associate of ISC², CEH, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), CCSP, or Google Associate Cloud Engineer are preferred. Responsibilities Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered features, AI assistants, and intelligent automation solutions to support Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) workflows. Build AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability summarization, log triage, remediation recommendations, security policy reviews, configuration assessments, and natural-language querying of security data. Develop responsive and scalable frontend applications using React.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for AI-powered internal tools and dashboards. Build and maintain backend AI services and APIs using Python, with Java-based backend development wherever required. Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and open-source models into enterprise applications. Design, develop, and optimize prompt templates, system prompts, structured-output schemas, and function-calling workflows. Implement end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document chunking, embeddings, vector store integration, retrieval optimization, and response grounding. Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent technologies. Build evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and regression test suites to measure LLM accuracy, hallucination rates, response quality, latency, and cost. Perform prompt engineering and continuously improve AI outputs through offline and online evaluations. Implement responsible AI and security controls, including prompt-injection protection, PII redaction, output filtering, rate limiting, audit logging, and access management. Integrate AI services with vulnerability scanners, ticketing platforms, SIEM solutions, monitoring tools, and other security infrastructure to enable automated security workflows. Automate AI/ML operations activities such as data preparation, embedding refresh, evaluation runs, health checks, and monitoring using Python and Shell scripting. Support application testing, debugging, performance tuning, and cost optimization to ensure reliable and scalable AI solutions. Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, deployment artifacts, and operational procedures. Collaborate with security, infrastructure, engineering, DevOps, and data teams to translate business requirements into practical AI-driven solutions. Apply infrastructure security principles and cloud security controls while designing and deploying AI services. Continuously evaluate emerging LLM models, frameworks, prompting techniques, and evaluation methodologies to improve solution quality and security posture.

description: Description Advance Your Career with Liberty Mutual's Personal Lines Casualty Team! Our Casualty Attorney Represented team is currently hiring for Senior Claims Specialists to manage attorney represented and litigated auto and homeowner's bodily injury claims. This role will manage, investigate and resolve claims as well as assist in providing prompt and quality service to policyholders for mild to moderate severity and/or complexity claims. Work Arrangement Hybrid: Candidates who live within 50 miles of a Liberty Mutual Claims office are expected to work on-site at least two days per month. Remote: Candidates who live more than 50 miles from a Liberty Mutual Claims office are eligible to work fully remote. The start date for the role is January 11, 2027. This position operates on an Eastern time schedule. Responsibilities: Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed authority levels. Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation. Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences and reports to Home Office and local management on status. Confers with trial counsel and prepares trial reports. Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims, refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary, and advise as to proper course of action. Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports. Ensures adequacy of reserves. Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files. Updates files and provides comprehensive reports as required. Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel. Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory. Preferred Qualifications: 1+ years Personal Lines Third-Party Auto Casualty Experience. 1+ years Attorney Represented Experience. Experience handling Litigated Third-Party Auto Casualty Claims. Experience handling Uninsured and Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) Claims. Qualifications Strong written and oral communications skills required. Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required. Customer service experience preferred. Demonstrated competency of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law. The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and at least 12-18 months of directly related experience. Ability to obtain proper licensing as required. Applicants residing in Washington state, California, or the District of Columbia are not eligible at this time. About Us Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role. At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions.
